title: Cancer Free — EN/KO/SW (Chas McIvor)
style: acoustic folk fingerpicked guitar Korean Swahili language learning quiet warm baritone 96bpm gentle brushed drums trilingual true story family relief intimate
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Six words. Cancer free.
Joel texted. Corey answered: "Awesome good."
That is correct. Awesome. Good.
Cancer free.

[Verse 2 - Korean, with English translations]
여섯 단어. 암이 없다. (Six words. Cancer free.)
조엘이 문자를 보냈다. 코리가 대답했다: "대단해 좋아." (Joel texted. Corey answered: Awesome good.)
그것은 맞다. 대단해. 좋아. (That is correct. Awesome. Good.)
암이 없다. (Cancer free.)
두 번 읽게 되는 종류의 읽기 (The kind of reading you do twice)
사실이 되게 하기 전에. (Before you let it be true.)

[Chorus - Swahili, with English translations]
Huru na saratani (Cancer free)
Kerry (Kerry)
Huru na saratani (Cancer free)
Simu ilifika (The call came through)
Huru na saratani (Cancer free)
Neno ambalo daktari alitumia (The word the doctor used)
Huru na saratani (Cancer free)
Joel alituma maneno sita (Joel sent six words)
Ambayo yalikuwa hadithi nzima (That were the whole story)
Huru na saratani — Kerry (Cancer free — Kerry)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Brothers are for telling each other the most important facts. Cancer free.
Korean: 형제들은 서로 가장 중요한 사실을 알리기 위해 있다. 암이 없다. (Brothers are for telling each other the most important facts. Cancer free.)
Swahili: Ndugu ni kwa ajili ya kuambia ukweli muhimu zaidi. Huru na saratani. (Brothers are for telling the most important facts. Cancer free.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Cancer free — Kerry — cancer free
Korean: 암이 없다 — 케리 — 암이 없다 (Cancer free — Kerry — cancer free)
Swahili: Huru na saratani — Kerry — huru (Cancer free — Kerry — free)
